A short video of the Smart LPG System at work.

Rehez Company builds useful things for Kurdistan.

Re Hez is licensed by the Kurdistan Regional Government and headquartered in Erbil. Smart LPG System is its first project, developed with international companies and experts from the United States.

We are the first to bring intelligent LPG management to households and businesses in the region, with safety built in and daily tasks made simpler.

Our mission: use modern technology and smart systems to improve essential parts of daily life, make them safer and reduce everyday burdens. Smart LPG is the beginning.

On 19 December 2024 we held our first seminar to announce the project, attended by government representatives and prominent figures from Erbil. It was welcomed as a step in line with the vision of the Kurdistan Regional Government.


National pride in every step, service in every action. Love for our homeland and limitless service to our citizens are the cornerstones of our success.Lawen Muhammad, Executive Director

One fixed tank. Filled where it stands.

The system supplies LPG for homes, villas, apartment complexes, housing projects and commercial facilities, safely and efficiently.

Fixed tank

No cylinder replacement. Our specialist team fills it directly on site, and the tank holds three times the volume of conventional cylinders.

Mobile app

Check your gas percentage and get an alert when the level drops. The gas-rate unit on site feeds the app.

Safe by design

Each line has a solenoid valve, filter, regulator, ball valves and a gas detector, installed by trained engineers.

How a refill works

We install the tank

Fixed tank, valve cabinet and gas detector, sized for your home or building.

The app tracks it

The gas-rate unit reports your level to the app.

You get an alert

When the level is low, you are notified and a 24-hour refill window opens.

We refill on site

Our filling truck arrives and tops up the tank. Gas costs the market price.

The LPG filling truck

A specialised vehicle that carries and delivers liquefied petroleum gas, with its own fire-safety equipment on board.

LPG tank3,000 L
Tank diameter / length150 cm / 200 cm
Wall thickness6 mm
Steel water tank1,000 L
Fire hose reel20 m, 1 inch
Also on boardGas loading system, water jet

Where the system is installed

Smart LPG is designed for single homes and for whole buildings.

Home kitchens

An 85 L cylinder feeds the kitchen through a valve cabinet with filter, regulator and solenoid valve, plus a gas detector.

Rose Garden

A multi-storey building supplied by a 5,000 L rooftop tank, with a metered line and gas detector in each apartment.

Commercial sites

Hotels, restaurants, cafeterias, government facilities and housing projects.

Coming next from Rehez: Wellness Center, Smart House, Mobile House, Smart Car Service.
